specs.name: isItEight_returns_bool
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Int) (h_precond : isItEight_precond n),
    isItEight n h_precond = true ∧ isItEight n h_precond = false

specs.name: isItEight_div8_true
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Int) (h_precond : isItEight_precond n),
    n % 8 == 0 → isItEight n h_precond = true

specs.name: isItEight_digit8_true
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Int) (h_precond : isItEight_precond n),
    (∃ i, (Int.natAbs n) / (10^i) % 10 == 8) → isItEight n h_precond = true

specs.name: isItEight_false_not_div8
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Int) (h_precond : isItEight_precond n),
    isItEight n h_precond = false → ¬(n % 8 == 0)

specs.name: isItEight_neg_eq
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Int) (h_precond : isItEight_precond n) (h_neg : isItEight_precond (-n)),
    isItEight n h_precond = isItEight (-n) h_neg

specs.name: isItEight_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Int) (h_precond : isItEight_precond n),
    isItEight n h_precond = true ↔ (n % 8 == 0 ∧ ∃ i, (Int.natAbs n) / (10^i) % 10 == 8)

specs.name: isItEight_false_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Int) (h_precond : isItEight_precond n),
    isItEight n h_precond = false ↔ (¬(n % 8 == 0) ∧ ∀ i, ¬((Int.natAbs n) / (10^i) % 10 == 8))

specs.name: isItEight_meets_postcond
specs.stmt: ∀ (n : Int) (h : isItEight_precond n), isItEight_postcond n (isItEight n h) h

specs.name: isItEight_single_digit_not_eight
specs.stmt: theorem isItEight_single_digit_not_eight : isItEight n trivial = false

specs.name: isItEight_digit_characterization
specs.stmt: Int) : isItEight n trivial = true ↔ (n % 8 == 0 ∨ ∃ i : Nat, (Int.natAbs n) / (10^i) % 10 == 8)
